title: The Benny Carter sides of 1941
summary: Discussion of 'What a Difference a Day Makes' and other Carter sides she hasn't heard in years.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Just before we leave Benny Carter, have you listened to those Benny Carter sides?
No, those were later. The two from 1941 are 'Midnight --
And 'What A Difference A Day Makes.'

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Yes. Someone just sent me a tape of those. In fact, I have -- Aren't they in the Benny Carter album that they just put out?
Well I taped these off a French RCA record. But it's not issued in this country as far as I know, unless it has been very recently.

I just heard it, let's say, this year myself of those selections. But somebody sent me the 78 -- no, the album in which the others were in which I mentioned. 'Looking For A Boy' and something else -- I forget. But I never heard those things when they first came out for years! And I just heard these two that you mentioned just this year.
'I'm The Caring Kind' if the other one from the --
Last session. Again, those I took off a foreign record. Something that was issued in England on the Ember label.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
It's a pity that there are not more available. They're terrific sides.
